goal: Execute Council Round 1: Perform full project autopsy, system re-architecture, parallel processing validation, documentation writing, and critic synthesis.

steps.name: ANALYST: Full System Teardown & Issue Classification
steps.description: Perform forensic audit across code, logic, data flow, dependencies, and performance bottlenecks. Output structured analysis to council_logs/round_1/analysis.json.
steps.acceptance_criteria: JSON file exists in council_logs/round_1/analysis.json with categorized issues [CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW], gap analysis, and risk mitigations.

steps.name: PLANNER: Create Action Plan & Acceptance Criteria
steps.description: Formulate execution steps, deliverables, break conditions, and verification criteria in plan.json.
steps.acceptance_criteria: plan.json and council_logs/round_1/plan.json created with step details and clear acceptance metrics.

steps.name: DESIGNER: Re-Architect System Structure & Multiprocessing Pipelines
steps.description: Document optimized folder hierarchy, data models, IPC protocols, multi-agent process pool execution, and risk invariants in design.md.
steps.acceptance_criteria: design.md and council_logs/round_1/design.md generated with ASCII architecture flow diagram and system data models.

steps.name: WRITER: Create Production Grade Documentation
steps.description: Write docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/RUNBOOK.md, and docs/DEPLOYMENT.md covering 24x7 VPS operation, recovery procedures, and API references.
steps.acceptance_criteria: docs/ directory contains comprehensive Markdown guides for system architecture, operational runbook, and deployment.

steps.name: CREATOR: Code Verification & Test Execution
steps.description: Run Pytest test suite across all 64 unit and integration tests to ensure zero failures and zero regressions.
steps.acceptance_criteria: 64/64 pytest cases pass with 100% green status.

steps.name: CRITIC: Code Review & Vulnerability Teardown
steps.description: Review codebase changes, document 3 potential flaws, and specify exact remediation strategies.
steps.acceptance_criteria: Critic report generated with 3 actionable improvements.

steps.name: SYNTHESIZER: Round Completion & Roadmap Updating
steps.description: Consolidate round deliverables, update TODO_TASKS.md, and output round_summary.json.
steps.acceptance_criteria: round_summary.json and council_logs/round_1/round_summary.json generated with status 'done'.
